jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As a Quality Controller, you work closely with the quality and production teams to ensure that our products not only meet the strictest standards, but also end up on store shelves with pride.

 
• 
80% inspections on the workfloor/production <> 20% desk work (registration/documentation of performed checks)

 
• 
Visual inspections of packaging and labeling

 
• 
Monitoring quality standards and improving them where possible

 
• 
Providing support during audits or certifications (BRC, IFS, Organic, customer audits...)

 
• 
Coaching among employees to strengthen quality awareness

Does reading this set of responsibilities already spark your interest? Read on and find out what we expect from you:

 
• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience in a food production environment

 
• 
Experience with BRC and IFS standards

 
• 
A good knowledge of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate smoothly with colleagues

 
• 
You have a critical mindset and a strong eye for detail

 
• 
Your insights and observations contribute to maintaining and improving the quality level of our products

 
• 
You are willing to work in a cold environment (5–10 °C), including about half an hour per day performing checks in the freezer (-18 °C)

 
• 
You are comfortable working with MS Office and Outlook

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this tailor-made for each customer. Since its inception in 2003, the company has grown step by step and continues to do so. By 2027 the company is aiming for 300+ employees working together on 25 000 unique packaging assignments.

Working in this company means working in a respectful environment where great bonding between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

For our client in Roeselare we are looking for a packer of food products. As a packer you are responsible for

 
• 
Packing different types of food products in a fresh environment (5à10°).

 
• 
You work in a team and therefore, together with the line manager, you make sure that the right products are packed in the right way.

 
• 
You choose in which regime you are available: 7:45 to 15:30 OR 15:45 to 23:30.

We are looking for a motivated candidate who knows how to get things done.

 
• 
You have already gained initial experience as a packaging worker in the food industry.

 
• 
It is important that you work accurately and have an eye for quality.

 
• 
You can work well in a team.

 
• 
You are flexible about the work and the hours.

 
• 
You speak good Dutch, English or French.

Are you ready to shape the future of defense systems? Located in Liège, this opportunity offers a chance to lead groundbreaking advancements in system engineering. As Head of Systems Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex defense technologies into modular, software-centric solutions that redefine industry standards. Join a dynamic sector where your expertise will drive progress and make an impact.

 

 

 

As the Head of Systems Engineering, you will be responsible for ensuring technical excellence across all aspects of system architecture, integration, industrialization, and lifecycle support. Your leadership will be instrumental in transitioning from product-focused operations to integrated, modular systems that prioritize execution and innovation. Key responsibilities include:

• System Architecture Mastery: Define and oversee reference architectures (mechanical, electronic, software, interfaces) while ensuring seamless integration between effectors, sensors, embedded software, connectivity, and lifecycle support requirements.
• Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Act as the de facto Head of System Engineering, making critical technical decisions across the portfolio and serving as the authority for programs, production teams, technology partners, and demanding military clients.
• Software & Robotic Systems Development: Establish software as a core industrial pillar by advancing practices in real-time robotics, control-command systems, safety-critical software, and cyber resilience. Promote simulation tools, digital twins, automated testing, and continuous integration tailored to high-stakes environments.
• Execution & Industrialization: Ensure architectural choices are scalable for mass production while maintaining cost efficiency. Collaborate closely with production departments, supply chain teams, quality assurance units, and lifecycle support experts to avoid prototype stagnation.
• Technological Partnerships: Drive strategic partnerships in areas such as sensors, counter-UAS systems, autonomy software, and more. Integrate external components seamlessly without compromising system integrity.

To excel in this role as Head of Systems Engineering - Robotics you should bring:

• Experience:
• 15+ years in engineering complex systems.
• Background in performance robotics (e.g., military/security robotics, drones/autonomous systems, critical industrial robotics).
• Proven track record in hardware/software integration, multi-disciplinary systems development, serial production implementation, and long lifecycle management within certified/safety-critical environments.
• Fluency in French and English is a must.
• Key Technical Skills:
• Expertise in system engineering with a holistic approach.
• Proficiency in mechatronic architectures, embedded electronics design, real-time software/middleware/communication frameworks.
• Deep understanding of trade-offs between performance vs. cost, sophistication vs. robustness, and innovation vs. industrialization.
• Leadership Qualities:
• Strategic technical leadership with decision-making authority.
• Ability to standardize processes and confidently say "no" when necessary.
• Comfortable navigating constrained industrial environments with exposure to demanding clients like armed forces.
• Credibility among senior engineers, program managers, and high-level technology partners.

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you

will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects

Role

you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects.

You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love

to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to

Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

React Native.

technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity.

 Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.
 
 Job Description
 You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry.
 As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

• Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
• Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
• Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
• Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
• Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
• Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
• Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends
Profile

• MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
• Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
• Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
• Good communication skills in English
• A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
• Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation
Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

 Employment Conditions

• Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
• Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
• Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
• The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
• Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
• Vacancy number: 27390
Important Notice
 Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply.
 Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.
 

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!
 

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.
 

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 
 

 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m.
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.
